en: I'm very AI-pilled, so it's hard to be, like, absolutely contrarian at the moment.
zh: 我非常 AI 化，所以现在很难做到，绝对的叛逆。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think this has...
zh: 我觉得这已经……

speaker: Unknown
en: Apocalypse, Frontier Labs dominating everything.
zh: 世界末日，前沿实验室主宰一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every tweet is like, they've just destroyed X industry with their little rapper.
zh: 每条推特都像是，他们刚用他们的小说唱手摧毁了 X 行业。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's so much work that goes into building a great business like Stripe or like anyone else.
zh: 建立一个像 Stripe 或其他人一样伟大的企业需要投入大量的工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's so much that you need to know.
zh: 有太多东西你需要知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: How much have you learned about payments that no one in the world needs to know?
zh: 关于支付，你学到了多少世界上没人需要知道的东西？

speaker: Unknown
en: No one should have to learn.
zh: 没人应该不得不去学。

speaker: Unknown
en: It is awful.
zh: 这太糟糕了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Too much.
zh: 太多了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Way too much.
zh: 实在太多了。

speaker: Unknown
en: But there's so much of that and so much craft that goes into building a great business.
zh: 但是有太多那样的东西，以及太多的工艺投入到建立一个伟大的企业中。

speaker: Unknown
en: consumer, business-to-business or business-to-consumer products that you're going to have, you're still going to have great software companies that are like completely vertical and really, really deep.
zh: 消费者，面向企业或面向消费者的产品，你会拥有，你仍然会拥有像完全垂直并且真的非常深度的伟大软件公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this kind of idea that someone wrote a prompt and they've just got a frontier model that's going to kill everything is wildly overblown and investors are just...
zh: 这种有人写了一个提示词并且他们刚得到了一个前沿模型就要扼杀一切的想法被极度夸大了，而投资者们只是……

speaker: Unknown
en: the silliest, most irrational people I've ever met in my life, and I can't believe they have all the capital.
zh: 我这辈子遇到过的最愚蠢、最不理性的人，我无法相信他们掌握了所有的资本。

speaker: Unknown
en: So people are kind of over-extrapolating from the...
zh: 所以人们有点过度推断了……

speaker: Unknown
en: They have no idea what's going on.
zh: 他们完全不知道发生了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: They don't have any technical knowledge at all, and they are in a world of they don't understand, so they're in a world of we're going to sit on the fence and just put money into the frontier labs.
zh: 他们根本没有任何技术知识，并且他们处在一个他们不理解的世界，所以他们处在一个我们要观望并只把钱投给前沿实验室的世界里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And Stripe, apparently.
zh: 还有 Stripe，显然。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's all they're going to do.
zh: 这就是他们要做的所有事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: But yeah, I think that rationality will play out in a couple of years, and you'll see valuations, multiples.
zh: 但是是的，我认为理性会在几年后显现出来，你会看到估值，倍数。

speaker: Unknown
en: The economy is driven by software.
zh: 经济由软件驱动。

speaker: Unknown
en: It has been for the last 30 years.
zh: 过去 30 年一直如此。

speaker: Unknown
en: We want more software companies.
zh: 我们想要更多软件公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: That is where GDP growth is going to come from.
zh: 这就是 GDP 增长将来自的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: We want more creative destruction.
zh: 我们想要更多创造性破坏。

speaker: Unknown
en: That is what AI is going to lead to.
zh: 这就是 AI 将要导致的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The abundance is not a contrarian take, but I'm pro-abundance.
zh: 富足不是一个受争议的观点，但我支持富足。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, that's a good note to end on.
zh: 不，那是结束的好注脚。

speaker: Unknown
en: You heard it here.
zh: 你们在这里听到了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Lots more creative destruction to come, and the story is not yet written, and it's not just, you know, a small number of firms that will be shipping everything useful.
zh: 还会有更多的创造性破坏即将到来，故事还没有被写完，而且不只是，你知道，少数公司会运送所有有用的东西。

en: With that, that brings our programming for Tour London to a close.
